thread:
Alex C: Quick heads-up — finalizing release notes & internal announce for Friday 09:00 PT. Need an owner for the pin, deploybot cadence check, and an evacuation fallback plan. I'll stub the RN draft in drive (link below).

Rachel: grabbing RN draft now. can we pin the runtime image to rwinf-api:2026-03-27-1 ? I want deterministic canary results.

Sam: +1 on pin. Ops: can we do a staggered canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 15m gates? DeployBot, is that how the cadence looks?

DeployBot: /deploy start --service rwinf-api --image rwinf-api:2026-03-27-1 --canary 5,25,100 --gate 15m

DeployBot: Scheduled canary at 2026-03-27T16:15:00Z. Will post status updates here. :robot_face:

Marta: I can own the evacuation lanes & rollback criteria. Proposing automatic rollback if:
- error rate increases >0.5% absolute over baseline
- 99p latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive gates
- token cost per request spikes by >30%

Sam: Sounds good. Also add a manual rollback trigger for customer-facing regressions (product will call it).

Alex C: RN owner still needed — Rachel, can you do the internal blurb? Keep it short: what's changing, impact, who to ping for rollback.

Rachel: I can. Drafting now; will ping for a quick approve by EOD.

Oncall-EE: Heads-up, I'll be on standby for the window. Can we add me to the staged pager for canary gates?

Alex C: Added Oncall-EE to the gate watchers. Also adding the \"quiet hours\" note: no non-critical deploys 08:00-12:00 PT that day.

Rachel: Draft done: \"Release: rwinf-api image 2026-03-27-1. Rollout: 5/25/100 with 15m gates. Owners: Rachel (comms), Marta (evacuation), Sam (deploy). Rollback criteria: SEE LIST. Oncall: Oncall-EE. Announcement will go to #eng and #customer-success at gate 2.\" Thoughts?

Sam: clean. add link to canary telemetry dashboard in RN.

Marta: added the rollback runbook steps (manual and automatic). Include the emergency contact list and the shorthand commands to revert: 
```
DeployBot: /deploy rollback --service rwinf-api --to-image rwinf-api:2026-03-20-4
kubectl scale deploy rwinf-api --replicas=0 (only if immediate kill required)
```

DeployBot: Canary gate 1 started — monitoring tokens, latency, errors. Status: nominal.

Alex C: :thumbsup: If gate 1 looks good at +15m, we'll hit gate 2 and post the internal announcement draft to #eng-releases then.

Rachel: request approvals from product and support now so we can post immediately at gate 2.

Oncall-EE: Received. I'll watch dashboards and be ready to escalate.

Marta: Evacuation checklist: 1) pin rollback image, 2) notify CS, 3) flip traffic via DeployBot, 4) open incident channel if rollback executes. I'll paste the checklist into the RN doc.

Rachel: Posting internal announce at gate 2 now (once Sam confirms gate 1 metrics). Will use this copy: \"Heads-up: rolling out rwinf-api -> 2026-03-27-1. Expected low risk. Contact Marta or Oncall-EE for rollback. Full notes: <link>\" 

Sam: Gate 1 metrics: error delta +0.02%, 99p latency +30ms, cost flat. Proceeding to gate 2.

DeployBot: Canary gate 2 started — targeting 25% traffic.

Alex C: Once gate 2 is good, we blast to #eng and snapshot the RN to the company drive and send to CS.

Rachel: Posted in #eng and scheduled the CS email for gate 3. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Rollout complete. 100% traffic. Status: success. :tada:

Marta: Closing evacuation plan — nothing triggered. Will keep runbook linked for 24h post-deploy.

Alex C: Great work team. Final actions: pin RN doc as 'release' in the drive, update changelog, and mark the deploy ticket done.

Rachel: Done — pinned RN and sent the internal digest. Thanks everyone.
